title: MM6 Thief
description: The native MM6 thief: slim adult human man with pale face and brown hair under a muted dark grey-green hood, shoulder mantle and long split cloak. Brown fitted leather jerkin with small native studs and panels, simple belt, dark charcoal trousers, brown boots. Preserve the native hood opening, narrow proportions, exposed hands, restrained leather detailing and any native weapon used in action. Original subdued pre-rendered fantasy art, soft baked lighting, plain worn cloth and dark tonal weight. No new armor, ornate embroidery or accessories. Native thin moustache and short facial hair. Grey-green undershirt shows at cuffs and lower jerkin edge. In attack use the two small plain silver daggers exactly as native poses show, one in each hand; none visible in standing. Cloak has native irregular worn dark patches, not decorative symbols.
regions: Only muted green hood, shoulder mantle, hanging cloak and native green undershirt cuffs/hem recolor; preserve skin, hair, leather jerkin, belt, trousers, boots and silver daggers.
